title: N.C.R.B., (M.H.A.) PRISON STATISTICS - 1996 The District Jails in Uttar Pradesh and Assam are capable of lodging a large number of inmates. The total capacity of inmates in the district jails of these States was 22450 and 5724 respectively with an average capacity of around 431 and 249 inmates per jail.
